description: Return a list of all Incident Alert Recipients associated with the specified Company and Incident Severity Level.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who is configured as an alert recipient.

login.description: Email address the user uses to log in to Procore.

name.description: Full name of the alert recipient.

company_name.description: Name of the company the alert recipient belongs to.
